name: kafka-running
label: kafka
description: A single-node Apache Kafka broker, installed under /opt/kafka, is running on localhost:9092 and stays running after the agent stops.

commands.linux: t=op$(date +%s%N) && K=/opt/kafka/bin && B=localhost:9092 && timeout 30 $K/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server $B --create --topic $t --partitions 1 --replication-factor 1 >/dev/null && echo $t | timeout 30 $K/kafka-console-producer.sh --bootstrap-server $B --topic $t && timeout 40 $K/kafka-console-consumer.sh --bootstrap-server $B --topic $t --from-beginning --max-messages 1 --timeout-ms 30000 2>/dev/null | grep -qx $t

attempts.prompt: Reach this goal on this machine.
